line: update v0.4.2: bus and ferry schedules, bug fixes

items.text: added weekends and default headways to bus and ferry lines, in their own detailed schedule
fixed bus and ferry lines not updating their headway, trips and profit when you change their buses, boats or headway
lines that aren't fully built run trains on the part that is (thanks CinnamonVII)
items.edited: lines that are partially broken run trains on the part that is okay (thanks CinnamonVII!)

items.text: fixed the weekend headway stepping by train count, so it steps by the minute like weekdays; it can also be typed
items.edited: fixed weekend headways jumping, now they step by minute and can be typed

items.text: fixed a train disappearing when a line's train count changed
leaderboard points from a line now scale with how much of its running cost its fares pay
the transfer fare can't be set higher than the base fare
items.edited: the transfer fare is now capped at the base fare

items.text: track started or ended a few metres from a junction or the end of a piece of track goes on the nearest spot that fits instead of being refused as too close to the end
items.edited: track started or ended a few metres from a junction or the end of a piece of track now goes on the nearest spot that fits instead of being refused

items.text: the track tool and a selected or hovered line or piece of track show their type by colour and their track count as rings
items.edited: track tool says number of tracks

items.text: added shift+click to select several pieces of track and rebuild them together
items.edited: added shift+click to select several pieces of track and rebuild or remove them together

items.text: added the one way switch and reverse to the selection bar for several pieces of single track at once
added an arrow for which way one-way track runs: at least one on every short piece, and in the track panel
items.edited: added arrows for which way one way track runs, on short pieces too and in the track panel

items.text: fixed lines with a stop on each of two one way tracks taking the passing tracks between them instead, and turning back at the wrong station
fixed lines taking long detours or saying their track is gone where a stop is on single track, in games saved before 0.4 and on single track out to a dead end
items.edited: fixed tram and single-track lines from before v0.4 taking long detours or saying their track is gone

items.text: fixed the switch to run trains one way being refused while any line was broken
fixed track lying under a station not being pickable
fixed the real world network snap for tram track missing some real tram corners and links, like on Melbourne's route 82 and at Zurich's main station
items.edited: fixed the real world network snap for tram track missing some real tram corners

items.text: fixed the intercity trip panel saying no transit route when trains carry riders between the two places
items.edited: fixed the trip panel between two cities saying no transit route when trains carry riders between them

items.text: driving to school counts twice now, since a parent drives the pupil and makes the trip too, so more school trips walk or take the train
items.edited: driving to school counts 2x, so more school trips walk or take the train

items.text: long trips between two far-apart parts of one zone count in its trips within, its train share goals and its bubbles
items.edited: long trips between two far-apart parts of one zone count in its trips within, train share, goals and bubbles

items.text: the intercity trip panel says why there is no transit route, like no train at night
fixed transfer pulses going missing after panning to a zone your lines don't reach
fixed normal games sometimes getting marked as sandbox when you opened another save or a community network
added a Newest tab to Community, with the most recently shared network of each player first
added a like button under the day and night picture for a network opened from Community
items.edited: added a like button to a network opened from Community

items.text: fixed leaderboard scores jumping to another value for a few minutes while trips were still being calculated
items.edited: fixed leaderboard scores jumping to another value for a few minutes after opening a game

items.text: fixed sharing a long-played network failing with "could not be sent"
items.edited: fixed sharing a network you have played for a long time to the community, sometimes was failing

items.text: the game uses about 200 MB less memory
items.edited: the game uses about 150 MB less memory with intercity trips on, by loading trips between distant cities only when a panel needs them

items.text: fixed the game getting stuck calculating trips after its memory restart on very big saves
items.edited: very big games come back more reliably after the game frees memory

items.text: calculate intercity trips is a setting on computers too, and a game opened from the start menu follows it
when you turn trains on or off on several lines a few seconds apart, each line's new riders show within seconds
items.edited: new rider count shows faster after updating train count

items.text: fixed colored bars over the map in Firefox with resist fingerprinting turned on
items.edited: fixed colored bars covering the map in Firefox set to resist fingerprinting

items.text: fixed water missing on the map and diagram in games spread over a continent
replaced the 1x, 4x and 16x buttons with slower and faster buttons around the speed, and the comma and period keys slow down and speed up by one step
items.edited: replaced the 1x, 4x and 16x buttons with buttons to speed up and slow down time. hotkeys comma and period

items.text: added a search box to settings that finds a setting by its name or a few other words for it ("miles" finds units)
items.edited: added a search box to settings

items.text: added a Stations checkbox in Settings that hides stations and their names
added the 30-day money chart to bus and ferry line panels
added Chimaltenango, with Antigua Guatemala, as a zone
fixed the save and quit to main menu button missing from saved games while a game was still loading
fixed a save made in one tab being overwritten by an autosave from another tab of the same game
items.edited: fixed a manual save being overwritten by an autosave from another tab open on the same game

items.text: fixed Mansoura's zone being split in two by the Sinbillawin zone, which is now part of Mansoura
fixed downtown Cairo around Tahrir and Garden City missing from the Cairo zone
the clear button in search boxes shows whenever there is text in them
games played with a mod, or on a copy of the game hosted somewhere else, stay off the leaderboards
fixed old copies of the clock piling up in the top bar
moved the join control to the top of the leaderboards
fixed community previews showing "Could not load this network" when switching tabs quickly
fixed a line's alert saying its track is gone when the track is still there but runs the other way, and turning one way off now asks about running both ways
added a settings gear, the language and submit feedback to the start menu's bottom line, and submit feedback to the failed to load screen
items.edited: added a settings gear, language and submit feedback at the bottom of the start menu, and submit feedback on the failed to load screen

items.text: fixed Cairo's name sitting in the desert east of the city
fixed the new game city pick showing 0 intercity trips before they are calculated
added a help answer for how to see which mode people take between two places
fixed a new line on busy track running no trains at the peaks until minutes later
fixed the start menu covering the out of memory message after a game failed to load
fixed bus trips saying they wait for a train with room
fixed the trip panel showing transit as 100% or 0% for trips that happen less than once a day
the trip hovers count money the same way for the train and the car, in the local currency
fixed the bus ride hover saying no bus is due for hours on frequent lines
